ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Given that the waveform of the signal \(x(t)\) is as shown in the figure, and its Fourier transform is \(X(\omega)\), then \(X(0) =\) ________.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the horizontal axis is t, and the vertical axis is x(t). The waveform consists of two rectangular pulses: the left side is between t=-2 and t=-1, with a height of +1; the right side is between t=1 and t=2, with a height of -1. Reasoning: The continuous-time Fourier transform at ω=0 satisfies X(0)=∫x(t)dt, that is, the signed area of the signal. The area of the left rectangle is 1×1=1, and the area of the right rectangle is (-1)×1=-1, so the total area is 1+(-1)=0. Therefore X(0)=0.
